  alert_id,
  alert_timestamp,
  customer_name,
  merchant_name,
  amount,
  currency,
  risk_level,
  action,
  reason_description,
  RIGHT(card_number, 4) AS card_last4
FROM finguard.gold.fraud_card_alert
ORDER BY alert_timestamp DESC
